outgoing.name: Irish Sea
outgoing.excerpt: In 914, the Annals of Ulster report the defeat of Barid son of Oitir by Ragnall grandson of Ivar in the Irish Sea.

outgoing.name: Wales
outgoing.excerpt: As if to prove the point, Athelstan imposed his authority on the kings of Wales, Hywel Dda and Idwal Foel among them.

outgoing.name: York
outgoing.excerpt: After Carham, Ragnall seized control of York.

outgoing.name: Christianity
outgoing.excerpt: …926 he had evidently acknowledged Athelstan as over-king, adopting Christianity and marrying a sister of Athelstan at Tamworth.

outgoing.name: Dublin
outgoing.excerpt: …mac Gofraidh (Olaf Guthfrithsson), the Uí Ímair king of Dublin, perhaps together with Owain of Strathclyde, are found…

outgoing.name: Leicester
outgoing.excerpt: …prompting of the Archbishops of Canterbury and York, near Leicester.
